notes.title: Dev Diaries Pt 2 - Programming
notes.content:
Hello you lovely people!

Here's part two of a Dev Diaries series we're doing for A Void Hope. If you like this one, there's already a part one released and part three is coming soon.
[previewyoutube=L1S-TOjB3gk;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]A Void Hope takes you on an atmospheric narrative adventure to find a cure for a collapsed city. Follow the story of a tormented couple as they try to decipher reality from nightmares and evade the shadowy threats lurking in the dark. [/i]

[list][*] Solve puzzles and find items to progress
[*] Avoid combat and embrace exploration
[*] Uncover the mystical story
[*] An evocative soundtrack by synthwave mastermind Waveshaper[/list]
Thanks everyone! :)

[b]Elden Pixels[/b]

notes.title: Release date is here - February 29!
notes.content:
Hello you lovely people!

We can finally announce that A Void Hope is coming on February 29th. The game will be available on Steam (PC, Mac & Linux), GOG and Nintendo Switch.

[i]A Void Hope takes you on an atmospheric narrative adventure to find a cure for a collapsed city. Follow the story of a tormented couple as they try to decipher reality from nightmares and evade the shadowy threats lurking in the dark. [/i]
[list][*] Solve puzzles and find items to progress
[*] Avoid combat and embrace exploration
[*] Uncover the mystical story
[*] An evocative soundtrack by synthwave mastermind Waveshaper[/list]
Here's the freshly made Relase Date Trailer. We're really happy how it turned out!
[previewyoutube=HB6M_C-dz4U;full][/previewyoutube]
Let us know what you think and if you have any questions :)

Thanks everyone!

[b]Elden Pixels[/b]
